description: Syntax-highlighted code in an editor window. Transparent PNG, ready to drop onto a Kdenlive track.

fields.code: Code text (\n for new lines) or a path to a code file
fields.lang: Language: ts, js, python, rust, bash... (auto from file extension)
fields.title: Window title (defaults to the file name)
fields.theme: Shiki theme (default: [brand].code_theme), e.g. github-dark, dracula, one-dark-pro
fields.width: Card width in px (default auto, max 1760)
fields.frame: card (default: PNG cropped to the card) or full (1920x1080 transparent frame, card centered, so every card lines up the same in Kdenlive)
